Addresses change_review.3b81bd85-575c-455e-b121-41487d726f51. Restrict NCC 1982 to the colour monitor, 64 KiB card, mouse, Entertainment Suite and CP/M/AIONix pointing updates. Give each preparation, preview, launch, developer and follow-up activity its own purpose and direct prerequisites. Remove duplicated product lists, event prices, source filenames and editorial commentary. Record the public introduction once as an execution-process result, not creation of the underlying hardware/software. Add missing product-owned NCC launch links before removing their reverse links. Correct the already-approved Mono Pro 17 and 128 KiB card launch links to the existing COMDEX 1982 launch, and select their November device revisions in the retail packages. Retire the NCC-specific professional graphics bundle: its version-1 engineering components remain in devices, while the distinct existing November retail bundle retains version-2 components and receives COMDEX launch links. Move ownership of the COMDEX launch from the development process boundary to the campaign process step, retaining the development end date and independent June engineering handover. Keep these linked scope, ownership and reference changes atomic; do not apply any of them without authorization. Earlier dependencies have already been approved. The mouse offering now retains only its package term and a composition link to device.logix_mouse; all ten technical specifications and both technology references already exist on that canonical device. The former alternate-history commentary is retained only in the review evidence.
